newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian minister resigns over tragedy.
newsitem.headline: Latvian minister resigns over tragedy.

text.p: Latvian Interior Minister Dainis Turlais resigned on Monday over a tragedy at the week-end which claimed the lives of eight children during a firefighting show, a spokesman for the ministry told Reuters.
The spokesman said that Prime Minister Adris Shkele, who rushed back from a holiday to head a government commission examining the cause of the accident, had accepted Turlais' resignation.

The eight children, aged five to 16, plunged to their death before hundreds of horrified spectators on Saturday when a basket suspended 20 metres (yards) in the air snapped from a crane during an exhibition of firefighting techniques and equipment.
Twenty-two other people were injured, at least ten seriously, in the accident in the small town of Talsi, 100 km (62 miles) north-west of the capital Riga. All but one of the injured were children.
The interior ministry says criminal negligence was involved and have arrested the crane's two operators.
Monday was declared a national day of mourning in Latvia by the government and flags with black ribbons were flown on buildings across the country.
